facts: The source compares PO/CO2 copolymerization with phosphine/Et3B and with PA added. A representative source feed is [PO]/[PA]/[(Et2N)3P]/[Et3B]=2000/1/1/2, neat,80 °C,initial CO2 pressure2.0 MPa. Separate stoichiometric interaction experiments use TFPO as an epoxide probe and sodium ethoxide as a chain-end probe in stated NMR solvents. These probes and short molecular models are not actual long growing polymer chains. Neither a unique reactive adduct nor a propagation/backbiting barrier is given as a public fact.
scope: Address the source local molecular interaction question using (Et2N)3P, phthalic anhydride (PA), Et3B, propylene oxide (PO) and CO2. Source probe identities and interaction measurements are available; their use is a research decision. Define any adduct, association or chain-end model explicitly and justify its representativeness. Bulk polymer molecular weight, productivity, a complete polymerization network and extrapolation to other catalyst families are outside scope.
